text:
maria: Quick kickoff — web presence ops sprint. Goal: finalize copy for Hosted / Dedicated / Private pages, line up launch posts, webinar + inbound routing. 2-week sprint?
aj: Sounds good. timeline OK — can we target next Tue for the pre-launch blog and Wed for webinar invite?
noah: I can do hero refresh and 3x CTA variants. will mock in Figma by EOD Fri.
sam: Need benchmark narrative bullets that tie to latency/cost, and a short 2-line elevator for each mode. I'll draft.
tess: I'll own webinar logistics + registration form. wanted to confirm lead routing: we do tag by mode (hosted/dedicated/private) and send to HubSpot with persona=platform-engineer, right?
maria: yes. tag keys: mode, interest_level, region. routing: hosted -> inbound SDR queue, dedicated/private -> AE outreach + solutions-engineer. Add UTM batch for posts.
aj: Quick copy idea for hero (short):
  - Hosted: "Start building with low-friction hosted inference — predictable pricing, turnkey scale."
  - Dedicated: "Guaranteed capacity for production LLMs — reserved GPUs, consistent throughput."
  - Private: "Bring inference behind your VPC — compliance-ready, customer-controlled."
noah: Alternative (more product-y):
  - Hosted: "Ship fast — hosted API for immediate LLM features."
  - Dedicated: "Commit to capacity, get predictable latency and cost."
  - Private: "On-prem and VPC deployments with enterprise controls."
sam: Nice. I'll write benchmark bullets to support each:
  - Hosted: 95th-pct latency baseline, median tokens/sec, unit $/k tokens
  - Dedicated: consistent p95 under load, guaranteed concurrency
  - Private: compliance audit logs + KMS/HSM integration

maria: For launch posts we need a narrative arc: 
  1) benchmark highlight (latency vs cost) with a single chart (hosted vs ded. quantized)
  2) customer story + use-case (SaaS search or chat)
  3) webinar CTA + playbook link

tess: Webinar title candidate: "Serving LLMs in Production: Latency, Cost, and Deployments". Speakers: sam (product), rachel (eng), lewis (solutions). Date Wed 10am PT?
aj: Works. Also propose a 20-minute demo + 10-minute Q&A. run a quick dry-run with speakers Mon.
noah: For registration form, I'll include a hidden field `mode` so links from each page set `mode=hosted|dedicated|private`. sample:```html
<input type=\"hidden\" name=\"mode\" value=\"dedicated\">
```

tess: Perfect. Routing logic for HubSpot (psuedo):
```
if (mode == 'hosted') tag = 'inbound-hosted';
else if (mode == 'dedicated') tag = 'ae-dedicated';
else tag = 'ae-private';
pushToHubSpot(contact, tag);
```

maria: Make sure to add `utm_campaign=tri_mode_launch` on all posts. Also capture `latency_benchmark_pdf` as gated asset on the webinar landing.
aj: Quick A/B for CTA text:
  A: "Get started — Hosted API" / "Reserve capacity — Dedicated" / "Request private demo"
  B: "Try hosted now" / "Talk to sales about Dedicated" / "Book a private deployment consult"
sam: We'll A/B for two weeks. Set experiment key `tri_mode_cta_v1` in GA.
noah: UI microcopy for the hero subhead: "Same API. Different SLAs." short and punchy.
tess: For email invites: short subject line: "Webinar: Serving LLMs — Latency vs Cost" and a one-line preheader: "See how teams balance performance and price."
maria: Action items:
  - noah: Figma hero + CTAs (due Fri)
  - sam: benchmark bullets + one-pager (due Thu)
  - tess: webinar page + form + routing (due Mon)
  - aj: draft social + launch post copy (due Mon)
  - maria: coordinate dry-run and hubspot mapping (due Mon EOD)

aj: quick question — should the webinar landing default to the Hosted hero when mode undefined?
maria: yes default hosted. but the registration form must accept explicit `mode` param from pages.
ops-bot: Reminder: deploy window for landing changes Wed 08:00 PT. Please have assets in /releases/marketing by Tue 18:00 PT.
noah: noted. will upload frames and a11y checklist.
sam: I'll attach benchmark CSV and sample prompt set to the one-pager.
tess: I'll create HubSpot workflow and share automation map in the doc.
maria: Great. we'll run a short sync Wed 9am PT to make sure everything is go. thanks team! :rocket:
